description.p: finterm is a native C++ desktop financial intelligence terminal featuring real-time market data, AI-powered analytics, multi-broker trading, portfolio management, and 1300+ Python analytics scripts.

ul.li: Real-time crypto and equity trading (Kraken, HyperLiquid, 18+ brokers)
AI chat with multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Ollama)
CFA-level Python analytics (equity, derivatives, fixed income, quant)
Voice commands via offline Whisper speech recognition
Visual workflow node editor with risk management

description.p: Version 4.0.10 — Markets and Futures become one tab: a single row of pages, each a canvas of widgets with a chart beside it. New market-condition widgets — conditions per asset class, the Treasury curve and 10Y–2Y, credit stress, fed funds, CPI, debt-to-GDP and Shiller's CAPE with their percentiles, cross-asset correlation, sovereign spreads and Strategy's premium to its bitcoin — for Markets and the dashboard. The weekly brief moves into News: choose its topics, detail and platforms, and post to X, Bluesky and Mastodon. Charts no longer fail when Yahoo rate-limits.

Version 4.0.9 — IPO Watch becomes Private Market: marketplace prices, funding rounds and the road to IPO on a dashboard of movable widgets. Earnings links each print's call webcast and release, and plays the call in finterm. Screens reopen as you left them. Extended hours are one number everywhere: the portfolio's EXT% and Equity Research's Extended Hours panel show the same pre-market, after-hours and overnight prices, each labelled with its session, and load in a fraction of a second. Every dataset — quotes, price history, company info, calendars, IPO deals, SEC filings — now has one source the whole app reads, so two screens can no longer disagree; a rate-limited answer is retried instead of shown as blank. Dead code and stale caches removed.

Version 4.0.8 — Ownership: the largest moves by every 13F filer, corrected for splits and CUSIP changes, dated and linked to the filing, with the price range each traded in; 5% stakes (13D / 13G) market-wide, with alerts; the 13F index keeps itself current from EDGAR. Equity Research shows the latest after-hours and pre-market session with range and volume. Reports print or save as PDF through the system dialog. Helper processes start and stop with the app.

Version 4.0.7 — the Futures screen is back, built around the forward curve, with spreads, positioning and a paper account whose stops and targets work; a Report tab that writes one investor report on a company; analyst targets that say how old they are; listed companies leave IPO Watch.
Version 4.0.6 — market data on Windows (the data process could not start there); every installer is now installed and checked for data before release.
Version 4.0.5 — AI replies carry only figures from the data they were given; forecasts state a direction, not a target; operating income as filed with the SEC; one-line tooltips.
Version 4.0.4 — AI chat with live voice, IPO Watch, Screener, Ownership, world markets.
Version 4.0.0 — Complete rewrite in native C++20 with Qt6.
